items.title: Cambricon chairman denies rumour of more than one million chips shipping next year
items.title_zh: 寒武纪董事长辟谣“明年芯片出货超100万颗”传闻
items.summary: At Cambricon's third-quarter 2026 results briefing today, chairman and general manager Chen Tianshi said the company has never communicated any figure for next year's chip shipments in response to market discussion of more than one million units, that company announcements are the effective channel through which all investors obtain information equally, and that any matter requiring disclosure will be handled in accordance with the rules
items.summary_zh: 在今日举行的 寒武纪 2026年第三季度业绩说明会上，针对市场有关“公司明年芯片出货量超过100万颗”的讨论， 寒武纪 董事长、总经理陈天石回应表示，公司从未进行过相关沟通，公司公告是所有投资者平等获取公司信息的有效途径，如涉及法规要求披露的重大事项，公司将依法履行信息披露义务，并提醒投资者以公司在上交所官网或公司官方
